   \[
   R_S(t) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} R_i(t)
   \]  

b) **Parallel Structure**:

   \[
   R_S(t) = 1 - \prod_{i=1}^{n} (1 - R_i(t))
   \]

   The reliability is calculated by breaking the system into serial and parallel substructures and applying the above formulas step-by-step. For example, if the system has two parallel branches, each with serial components, the reliability is:  
   \[
   R_S(t) = 1 - \left(1 - \prod_{i \in \text{Branch 1}} R_i(t)\right) \left(1 - \prod_{j \in \text{Branch 2}} R_j(t)\right)
   \]
